name.en: Elective clinical clerkship in basic-science departments abroad
name.ja: 選択臨床実習 基礎系専門分野配属海外派遣留学プログラム

audience.en: Fifth- and sixth-year medical students with strong research motivation
audience.ja: 研究意欲の高い、5年生・6年生の学生

funding.en: Shibahara Fund support of up to JPY 1.5 million, adjusted by destination and period. It covers travel, living costs, tuition, bench fees and insurance.
funding.ja: 柴原慶一基金から最大150万円（派遣先と期間により調整）。渡航費、滞在費、授業料、ベンチフィー、保険料などを支援

eligibility.en: Fifth- and sixth-year medical students, as part of the elective clerkship.
eligibility.ja: 選択臨床実習の一環として行う5年生・6年生

howToApply.en: Details are announced on TACT, and briefings are held from time to time. Ask the office.
howToApply.ja: 詳細はTACTで案内します。説明会も随時あります。国際連携室に問い合わせてください

text.en: Next call: not announced. Calls are posted on TACT; ask the office when the next one is expected.
text.ja: 次回の募集は未定です。募集はTACTで案内されます。次の募集の時期は国際連携室に確認してください

toConfirm: Host institutions, application period, selection and credit arrangements: the programme page on both old sites says only that it is under construction.
Month the next call is expected, and the TACT course or notice board where it appears.
